summary: Iteration 2 testing (Host Controls, Raise Hand + Reactions, Dashboard, Waiting Room). Backend: 21/21 pytest passed. Covers auth, meetings CRUD with scheduled_at + waiting_room, PATCH/DELETE with host-only 403 + 404, WS auto-admit when waiting_room=false, WS waiting-room flow (waiting/knock/admit/peer-joined), host-controls (host-mute -> force-mute, pin broadcast, host-remove -> removed + peer-left), non-host ignored, raise-hand + reaction broadcast, deny flow. Frontend: admin logged in via UI, navigated to /dashboard via nav-dashboard-btn, created instant meeting (no schedule) -> auto-navigated to /j/{code} lobby, created scheduled meeting -> appeared under 'Upcoming', copy/join/delete buttons functional (delete removed the row live). Meeting room: local-video-tile + full control bar rendered including new raise-hand-btn and reactions-btn; clicking raise-hand highlighted it (orange), reactions-btn opened emoji-picker with react-<emoji> buttons and 🎉 clickable (reaction floated over UI, seen in screenshot). Chat and People side panels toggle correctly (host badge shown).
critical_code_review_comments: MeetingUpdate: passing null scheduled_at is filtered out by `{k:v for k,v in ... if v is not None}` so you cannot CLEAR a scheduled_at via PATCH — consider Field(default=UNSET) sentinel or accept empty string.

signaling(): unauthenticated WS still lets any client claim any peer_id server-generates (fine), but `token` in join is only used to determine host; consider validating token expiry (already covered by jwt.decode) but not user existence in DB (mismatch with REST which does).
peer-left broadcast on host-remove excludes the removed peer but includes host; that matches spec (‘other peers receive peer-left’).
Dashboard.jsx: `past = meetings.filter((m) => !upcoming.includes(m))` uses object identity which works because same array, but is O(n^2); trivial for MVP.
server.py rooms dict is in-memory — multi-worker/replica deployment would break signaling. Acceptable for single-worker MVP.
MeetingCreate.title Optional but default 'Instant Meeting' — good; POST /meetings accepts empty body.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed meetings via API + UI; test_cleanup deletes them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py has state deps across tests (uses pytest.<attr> module attrs). Run the full suite: `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -o addopts=''`. WS tests need admin_token fixture. Frontend uses data-testid selectors matching spec. Camera in headless yields green fallback tile (expected).
